name: EAR YOGA
trialStarts: first launch on device; countdown preserved across updates
notes: Mobile release1.67: build number inset 16px farther from the rounded right screen edge, with safe-area support. Selected Capsule mode buttons and approved spacing; earned mode admission, flight previews, adaptive Master lessons, and personal 3D skill orbit. The preferred shallow orbit view is shared by opening and Reset. Lotus placed closer to the Y in the shared wordmark.  Read-only 3D skill planet with 41 scale satellites, actual cumulative and recent local teacher statistics, formula/example detail and original audio lessons. No fabricated chord/tension history.  More closely grouped mode rows below the planet horizon and a large-cover comparison strip for all five button shapes. Full-cover mode-button atelier with four alternative contour studies, local persistence, drag, scaling and reset. The old lower reference backdrop now feathers into the continuous planet without a horizontal seam. Cadet / Pilot / Navigator / Master / Guru labels. Loopback desktop testing access is immediate and never persisted; mobile Epic passage accepts an independent three-star core performance and ignores incidental flying-tone slips. Demo feedback merged into one panel bounded by actual answer buttons. Student freely available, earned Teacher/Professor admission, hidden Cinematic Epic passage, read-only flight previews, upper experimental row and ivory selected mode. Adaptive Professor lessons and recurring-pattern review; Professor pace reduced by 3%. Centered scale/formula tags use bright pickup points and swept collision. Modes unlock after one third of the route; common modes dominate context/arrival-weighted offers, with tiered NAV/score rewards and fair paired tensions. Independent same-onset combos show small translucent receipts and bounded incremental bonuses. Achievements and secondary headers use the approved Variant3 wordmark/lotus. Professor combines twelve tensions/O2 with 41 compact flying scales/NAV, scoped selected-tone compatibility, soft auditions and family switches; Guru is reserved. The cover has a staggered 3+2 category layout. Professor ratings are separate. Correct near/far planet occlusion around the stationary skill axis, including planet taps and drags across signs. Favorites has its own planet and the map header uses the selected Variant3 lettering and lotus. All partial option filters now allow up to four stars; full reveals allow up to two. Expandable best-rating receipt explains hints and star thresholds. Audio fades out before background suspension; delayed notes are cancelled. Exact user-selected cover Variant3 (Cormorant / Forum, original lotus and positioned Manrope Settings), with locally cached fonts. Choose route opens the interactive planetary journey map. Each world offers a random flight or a route carousel. Five-star best results and completed-route percentages are saved separately from proficiency achievements; planet ratings average completed routes. Natural drag, overhead view, zoom, no Saturn rings, seven vertical jewel awards and a consistent wordmark. Existing harmony, timbres, terrain, Teacher +7%, Student flying notes and saved progress are preserved.
